rubric_items.reason: All 11 known REQs and the assumed REQ-12 are each traced by exactly one story (S-1 to S-5).
S-2 to S-5 are small. S-1 bundles five REQs (column, selection, time, doctor, exclusion), but it can be defended as one column outcome.
All criteria use Given/When/Then and can be checked. No AC covers a Scheduled appointment whose start has passed, and the S-1 AC3 format is still open (Q-01).
The values 20, Asia/Kolkata, "None" and the status names all come from the intent. The medical-history fields come from the glossary, which the intent cites.
The stories are clear and use consistent terms. One leftover wording difference remains between the front matter and the body for S-4 AC2.
